_readme: Default configs for scripts/chunk_embed_bench.py — an OFFLINE chunk x embedder x
reranker recall benchmark. No LightRAG, no ingest, no LLM extraction: chunk the
documents, embed chunks and questions, rank by cosine, optionally rerank, and check
whether each probe's gold evidence quote is in the top-k chunks.
Run it on the Thinkpad, where the corpus is. Nothing here reads the store:
.venv/bin/python scripts/chunk_embed_bench.py \
--corpus ~/rag-project/probe/loop_corpus.json \
--probes ~/rag-project/probe/solvay-dev-v1.jsonl ~/rag-project/probe/solvay-heldout-v1.jsonl \
--out ~/rag-project/probe/chunk-bench \
--configs docs/ops/loop/chunk-embed-bench-configs.json \
--embed-url http://127.0.0.1:8080 --api-key-env OMLX_API_KEY \
--embed-tokenizer ~/models/bge-m3 \
--rerank-url http://127.0.0.1:8080 --rerank-model jina-reranker-v3-mlx \
--compare structure-1500 fixed-1200-100
The script refuses an --embed-url or --rerank-url on port 9621 (LightRAG) or 8020
(gateway): it talks to the model server, never to the stack under production use.
EMBEDDER: BGE-M3 only (operator decision, 2026-10-18). mxbai-embed-large-v1 is
retired and its arms are gone. The ids below are the ones oMLX actually serves —
bge-m3-mlx-fp16 and jina-reranker-v3-mlx — and they must stay exact, because the
embedding cache key includes the model name: a wrong id is a silent re-embed of the
whole corpus, not an error. BGE-M3's window is 8192 tokens, dense 1024-dim, no
query/doc prefix.
CHUNK SIZE: the production shape has no size target. app/structure_chunker.py cuts a
document at its natural boundaries (a section, a table, a run of turns) and cuts only
when a unit cannot fit the embedder window; below a merge floor (150) a unit is welded
to its neighbour instead of standing alone. The two fixed-* arms are kept purely as
references for what blind cutting did; the structure-* arms cap on purpose (700,
1500) because a size curve is only meaningful if the curve has points on it — the
arm named structure-1500 is NOT the production shape, it is the shape with a cap.
The structure-* arms call app/structure_chunker.chunk_document — the shipped
pre-chunker the worker uses behind STRUCTURE_CHUNKING_ENABLED and the loop uses via
the structure_chunking experiment key — so a win here transfers to ingest by
construction. max_piece_tokens covers body PLUS the context header, counted in that
module's own conservative estimate, which is stricter than this script's tokenizer;
chunk token columns are therefore slightly under the cap.
One honest caveat: the benchmark passes an empty filename (documents are addressed
position, and a corpus file name must never reach a chunk, an embedding input or a
report), so those headers carry only [Section: ... | Part k/n] and not the title and
date the ingest gets. Treat structure-* recall as a lower bound for ingest.
structure-*-shuffled is a placebo, not a bug: same words, wrong attachment. If it
scores the same as the honest arm, the header is not doing the work and the argument
for it collapses.
--embed-tokenizer points at LOCAL BGE-M3 tokenizer files (tokenizer.json). It counts
every chunk with the served embedder's own vocabulary and reports over_embedder_window_*
against the 8192-token window including special tokens. Never downloaded: a hub id is
refused with the fetch command to run yourself. Without it the report says NOT LOADED
and the window columns are labelled as a stand-in.
The rerank request body is the Cohere shape (documents as plain strings). oMLX answers
HTTP 422 to the Jina shape (results of {text: ...}), which is what the first scratch run
hit; the response is read from results[] or data[] either way.
Sanity check before trusting anything: compare configs against each other and do not
quote absolute chunk counts as a production number — the local chunkers approximate.
A structure arm that lost text exits 4 and prints the probe ids under LOST TEXT
(--allow-lost-text publishes it anyway); a chunker that ate the text and a ranker that
ranked it badly are different findings and are never mixed into one number.
tiktoken is not installed in this venv, so runs here report
tokenizer=whitespace-fallback and their token counts are optimistic. Install tiktoken
on the Thinkpad (or pass --tokenizer tiktoken to fail loudly) before using the token
percentiles as a window argument.

configs.name: fixed-1200-100
configs._note: What production cutting does today: blind token windows. The reference for everything else.

configs.name: fixed-350-50
configs._note: The old recommended size, kept as the second reference point: small blind chunks, sentence separators.

configs.name: structure-700
configs._note: The shipped structure-aware pre-chunker, capped at 700 (body+header) so the size curve has a low point. Cuts at natural boundaries; table header row repeated on every piece of a split table.

configs.name: structure-700-nohdr
configs._note: No context header at all: prices the header itself against structure-700.

configs.name: structure-700-shuffled
configs._note: Placebo: the same headers, attached to the WRONG pieces. A real win must beat this, not merely beat nohdr — if the gain were just extra tokens, a wrong header would work as well.

configs.name: structure-1500
configs._note: Same chunker, cap three times higher: with BGE-M3 the cap stops being the binding constraint, so this measures how much the boundaries matter once size does not.

configs.name: structure-1500-nohdr
configs._note: Header price at the high cap.
